How Our Doorstep Service Works

No unexpected billing, no forced part replacements. We inspect, explain, and only proceed with your clear consent.

01

Request Online or via WhatsApp

Select your kitchen appliance, describe the problem, and pick your preferred doorstep time slot or tap for instant WhatsApp booking.

Step 1 of 4
02

Doorstep Visit and Detailed Diagnosis

Our certified technician reaches your doorstep within 60–90 minutes equipped with diagnostic tools to inspect the root cause.

Step 2 of 4
03

Upfront Estimate and Customer Approval

We explain the exact issue and provide a transparent, fixed quotation. Repair work begins ONLY after your explicit approval.

Step 3 of 4
04

Precision Repair and 30-Day Warranty

Your appliance is restored with 100% genuine spares, safety-checked, and backed by our hassle-free 30-day service guarantee.

Step 4 of 4
Customer Approval Guarantee:

If you choose not to proceed after diagnosis, you pay only the nominal visiting fee. No high-pressure sales pitches, ever.

Home Appliance Repair and Service Support in Howrah, West Bengal: Service Support Hub helps residents explore multi-brand appliance repair, maintenance, installation and doorstep diagnosis options in Howrah. Customers can review support for air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, televisions, microwaves, kitchen chimneys, gas hobs, geysers and other household appliances. Local availability, travel coverage, appointment timing and service estimates are confirmed for the customer’s specific locality and appliance before a visit is finalized.

Welcome to Service Support Hub, your convenient destination for exploring multi-brand home appliance repair, maintenance, installation, and technical support services. We help customers find service assistance for a wide range of household products, whether they need an AC service center, refrigerator repair center, washing machine service, LED or Smart TV repair, or support for another essential appliance. Our aim is to make it easier to understand available service options, share an appliance concern, and request a suitable doorstep visit.

Our home appliance service categories include air conditioners, refrigerators, deep freezers, washing machines, televisions, microwave ovens, kitchen chimneys, built-in gas hobs, cooking stoves, geysers, water purifiers, RO systems, and dishwashers. Service assistance may cover inspection, fault diagnosis, cleaning, maintenance, installation, component replacement, and repair, depending on the product and location. We also help customers explore technical support for IT and electronic equipment, including laptops, desktop computers, computer peripherals, printers, CCTV cameras, and related networking devices. Availability is confirmed according to the service type and local coverage.

Service Support Hub is designed for customers searching for brand-related service and repair assistance in one place. You can explore options for popular appliance brands such as LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, IFB, Bosch, Haier, Godrej, Daikin, Voltas, Sony, Panasonic, Faber, Elica, Kaff, Glen, Kent, and Aquaguard, along with other supported brands. We are an independent multi-brand service platform and are not claiming to be the official service center of every brand. Brand names are used only to help identify the products customers may need assistance with.

Clear communication is an important part of our service approach. The technician can inspect the reported issue, explain the diagnosis, and share an estimate for approval before repair work begins. Service charges, spare-part requirements, appointment availability, and any applicable workmanship or parts warranty are confirmed for the specific job. Warranty coverage, exclusions, and claim conditions are subject to the written terms shared at the time of service.

We aim to make local service discovery easier across locations. Explore appliance service information for Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Meerut, Muzaffarnagar, Delhi, Chandigarh, Faridabad, and Gurugram. Coverage and appointment slots can differ by area, appliance, and service requirement.

Whether you are looking for a brand-wise appliance repair center, home appliance maintenance, computer and IT support, or CCTV-related technical assistance, explore our service categories and contact Service Support Hub to discuss your requirement. We encourage customers to confirm the product model, issue, location, estimate, and applicable service terms before approving a booking.

Frequently Asked Questions

Got Questions? We Have Answers

Everything you need to know about our visiting charges, appointment scheduling, spare parts warranty, and diagnostic process.

Under standard conditions, our technician can reach your doorstep within 60 to 90 minutes of booking confirmation in Howrah, depending on your locality and the time of day. You can also schedule an appointment for a preferred date and time slot.

A visiting or inspection fee starts from ₹199 depending on the appliance. If you go ahead with the repair, the visiting charge is adjusted in the final repair invoice. The estimate is always shared for approval before work starts.

Eligible repair work may include a 30-day service warranty. Coverage, exclusions and claim requirements depend on the written warranty terms shared for the service.

The most common culprit is heavy grease clogging the baffle or mesh filters, or oil coating the blower fan blades. In auto-clean chimneys a faulty heating coil can stop the oil from draining. A deep clean or duct unblocking normally restores suction.

A yellow flame indicates incomplete combustion. It is usually caused by clogged burner ports or jets, spills blocking the air intake, or low or unsteady regulator pressure. Cleaning and re-setting the burner restores a clean blue flame.

Continuous clicking usually points to moisture or food residue at the spark plug or a jammed ignition switch. It rarely causes immediate danger, but switch off the electrical supply and the gas knob and book a visit to avoid damaging the pulse generator.

This usually indicates a failed magnetron, a blown high-voltage diode or capacitor, or a faulty transformer. These parts carry high voltage, so please do not open the oven yourself.

Typical reasons are a failing compressor or start relay, a faulty thermostat or sensor, an evaporator fan that has stopped, a frost-blocked coil, or a gas leak. Cooling in the freezer but not in the fridge section often points to a fan, damper or defrost problem.

Common causes are an unbalanced or overloaded drum, a worn belt or motor coupler, a faulty lid or door lock switch, a motor or capacitor problem, or a PCB fault. The technician checks these before suggesting any part.

Common causes are dirty filters or coils, low refrigerant because of a leak, a weak compressor or capacitor, a faulty sensor, or a blocked outdoor unit. A technician checks airflow, pressure and electrical parts first, and shares the estimate before any repair.

Sound with a black screen usually points to a failed backlight (LED strip or driver) or a main-board or T-con fault. Shine a torch at the screen at an angle; a faint image confirms a backlight problem.

A burnt heating element, a faulty thermostat or thermal cut-out, a power-supply problem or heavy scale build-up are the usual reasons. The technician tests each of them before recommending a part.

Choked sediment or carbon filters, a weak pump, a clogged membrane or low inlet pressure are the common causes. Filters usually need replacement every 6 to 12 months depending on water quality.

Power supply (SMPS) failure, loose or corroded BNC/RJ45 connectors, damaged cable or a faulty camera or DVR/NVR port are the usual causes. The technician checks them one by one.

A blocked filter, kinked or clogged drain hose, or a failed drain pump are the usual causes. Clean the filter as per the manual and book a visit if water remains.
